sections.description: DJ Night Club WordPress Theme we’ve designed offers vibe, enables you (as Disc Jockey, music conductor club instrument player) to display your skills and makes getting in touch with you effortless for customers in search of DJ artists. It features high energy elements to help visitors and potential customers catch the DJ service providers’ vibe immediately. Photo gallery is an important part of DJ website and DJ Night Club WordPress Theme offers the same to upload new images, replace old concert images with new ones with just a few clicks. You can publish images of crowd, your high end equipment and experts at work in the background. This will help you build trust and transparency with your audience. The template has multiple sections along with sticky header for visitors and customers to be able to notice all the important news and information about your work and expertise. As a mark of social proof there is scope to create a customer testimonial section, fan page. You can upload your company logo, logos of the companies and corporates who’ve worked with you, hired your services or for whom you’ve performed or worked with. Call to action buttons like Book DJ Services; make a call to discuss work, and check availability are available, free to use. We’ve given the theme a technical edge by making it a mobile friendly template. It is ready to use that you will take a few minutes to download and within next few hours you will be able to make your DJ service live online. Besides being responsive it is optimized for speed (we’ve used simple coding which makes the template light weight.) It is compatible for plugins like woo commerce which makes online payment for advance booking possible. Besides, DJ Night Club WordPress Theme is also compatible with audio plug-ins required for DJ portfolio.
